depiction.primary_object: downward arrow above horizontal bar inside circle
depiction.composition: centered glyph inside a circular outline

ambiguity: Similar to plain downward navigation arrows or uncircled download icons, though the bottom bar makes 'download' unambiguous.

modifier_semantics.meaning: destination surface or local storage (turns down arrow into download)
contained action button or status badge

reasoning: A universally recognized download symbol (down arrow onto a horizontal baseline inside a circle). It is the best icon when the core action of the task is downloading files for offline use, exporting archives, installing software, or managing the Downloads folder, though when a specific object (like a movie, book, or map) is more salient, an object icon may compete.
